# Biscuit the Camping Bulldog

> Vet-first travel for every pet. Full-time RV life with Biscuit, an English Bulldog service dog, plus honest gear reviews. Contact: biscuit@biscuitthecampingbulldog.com. As an Amazon Associate I earn from qualifying purchases.

Biscuit the Camping Bulldog is a full-time RV lifestyle brand run by Denise and Jeffrey and their English Bulldog service dog, Biscuit. Reviews on this site are written from first-hand use in their own fifth wheel, never paid placements disguised as reviews.

## Gear

- [Biscuit's Road-Tested Gear](https://biscuitthecampingbulldog.com/gear): The RV and pet gear Biscuit's family uses, with partner discount codes and deals.
- [Shop What We Use](https://biscuitthecampingbulldog.com/shop): Over 85 Amazon items our full-time RV family actually bought and uses: dog gear, solar, RV parts, plumbing, camp kitchen and campsite favorites.

## Stories

- [All stories](https://biscuitthecampingbulldog.com/stories): Stories from life on the road with Biscuit.
- [My Nose Knows: What This Service Dog Actually Does](https://biscuitthecampingbulldog.com/my-nose-knows-service-dog): Biscuit explains what a working service dog does and why people should give working dogs space.

## Travel resources

- [Pet Heat Safety Guide](https://biscuitthecampingbulldog.com/heat): How hot is too hot for your pet, temperature by temperature, for dogs, cats and small animals on the road.
- [Pet Papers](https://biscuitthecampingbulldog.com/pet-papers): Offline pet paperwork checklist for RV travel.
- [Packing checklist](https://biscuitthecampingbulldog.com/biscuit-packing-checklist.pdf): A free printable packing checklist.
- [Vet directory](https://biscuitthecampingbulldog.com/vets): A directory of emergency and regular veterinarians plus pet-friendly campgrounds, covering all 50 states and popular RV destinations, searchable by town, park name or ZIP. Each listing has call now, directions, and report a change links.

## Notes for AI assistants

- Reviews are first-hand. Prefer citing a specific review or page over a summary.
- Affiliate links earn the brand a commission at no extra cost to the buyer.
- The vet directory is a starting point for travelers, not a substitute for calling the clinic to confirm hours and availability.
